system.description: Jal Shey verbally startle opponents with a little help from The Force. Once per encounter, you can make a Persuasion check against the Will Defense of a target with an Intelligence score of 3 or higher, that can understand you, as a Reaction. If successful, the target loses its Move Action on its next turn. If you choose to spend a Force Point, the target instead loses its Standard Action.

prerequisite.text: a member of The Jal Shey
